title: OpenArm API error codes
description: Single source of truth for result_code values returned by the OpenArm JSON gateway. Mirror of openarm_skills/include/openarm_skills/error_codes.hpp.

errors.name: PLAN_FAILED
errors.description: MoveIt failed to plan or Cartesian path fraction below threshold (after server-side retries).

errors.name: GRIP_NOT_HELD
errors.description: Finger position indicates an empty grasp after the configured retry.

errors.name: EXECUTE_FAILED
errors.description: Trajectory was planned but the controller refused / failed execution.

errors.name: CAMERA_NO_CLOUD
errors.description: Perception service unreachable or no point cloud arrived.

errors.name: CAMERA_NO_TARGET
errors.description: The requested target_name was not found in the scene.

errors.name: CAMERA_OUT_OF_RANGE
errors.description: Computed pose is outside the configured workspace bounds.

errors.name: BAD_REQUEST
errors.description: JSON Schema validation failed or argument out of range.

errors.name: INTERNAL_ERROR
errors.description: Unexpected exception in the gateway or skill server.
